description: Convert a CSS length between px, rem, em, %, pt, pc, in, cm, mm, vw, vh, vmin and vmax, using a root font size, parent font size and viewport size (defaults 16px / 16px / 1440×900). Uses the CSS definition of 96px per inch. Returns every unit, rounded to 4 decimals by default. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/css-units/

decimals.description: Decimal places to round to. Default 4.

parentFontSize.description: Parent element font size in px, for em and %. Default 16.

rootFontSize.description: Root (html) font size in px, for rem. Default 16.

viewportHeight.description: Viewport height in px, for vh/vmin/vmax. Default 900.

viewportWidth.description: Viewport width in px, for vw/vmin/vmax. Default 1440.

name: css_units
title: CSS unit converter
